# certsecure_cas (Data Source)

Lists the CAs the provider's token may enroll from in CertSecure. Use the names as `ca_name` in `certsecure_certificate`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All CAs the token may enroll from.
data "certsecure_cas" "all" {}

# Only Microsoft CAs.
data "certsecure_cas" "msca" {
  type = "MSCA"
}

output "msca_names" {
  value = data.certsecure_cas.msca.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Only return CAs of this type, e.g. `MSCA` for Microsoft CA. Case-insensitive.

### Read-Only

- `cas` (Attributes List) CAs with their details, sorted by type and name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cas))
- `names` (List of String) CA names, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--cas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cas`

Read-Only:

- `connectors` (List of String) CertSecure connectors that serve this CA.
- `name` (String) CA name.
- `type` (String) CA type as reported by CertSecure, e.g. `MSCA`.
